correctness.rationale: From independent iid update derive covariance T=[[m²+η²σ²,−2βm,β²],[m,−β,0],[1,0,0]], m=1+β−ηµ. Independently symbolically checked det(I−T)=(1+β)η[2µ(1−β)−η((1−β)µ²/(1+β)+σ²)], positive-definite quadratic V and exact conditional drift minus same coefficient times x². Telescoping proves convergence for any deterministic initial pair strictly below bound. At the endpoint T has eigenvalue one; above det(I−T)<0 entails a real eigenvalue >1, and the three deterministic rank-one moment starts span all symmetric moment arrays, proving necessity. The β-derivative is exactly factored; v∈(0,1), v≥1 and v=0 limit cases handled. Independent SymPy det/drift/derivative checks all exact. Assumes scalar iid positive curvature with finite second moment; not general acceleration rates.
